project.title: Teigetje & Woelrat
project.description: Collection website for the Amsterdam fashion label Teigetje & Woelrat, designed in Figma and built for the web.
project.introText: A collection website for Teigetje & Woelrat, an Amsterdam label working across fashion, design and interior art. I designed it in Figma and built it as a React site.

gridImages.caption: Collection pieces, each with its name, category and year.
More of the collection: each piece with its name, category and price.
Archived Pieces: garments from past collections, with their own filters.
History page: how the label began.

project.middleText: The site has a collection page of ready-to-wear pieces with filters, an archive of pieces from past collections, a history of the label told as a timeline from 1972 onwards, an about page and a contact page, all in English and Dutch.
project.conclusionText: Built with React, TypeScript and Vite from the Figma design.
project.highlightCaption: Collection page, with filters for browsing the pieces.

summary.brief: A collection website for an Amsterdam label working across fashion, design and interior art.
summary.role: Design in Figma and front-end development.
summary.method: Collection and archive pages with filters, the label's history as a timeline, English and Dutch throughout.
summary.outcome: A bilingual site for the label's collection and archive.

facts: sections: collection, archive, history, about, contact
project.shows: A client commission taken from Figma design to a working bilingual website.
